performance.title: Largest Contentful Paint
performance.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-largest-contentful-paint/)
performance.why: The main visible content is taking 14.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
performance.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

performance.title: Total Blocking Time
performance.description: Sum of all time periods between FCP and Time to Interactive, when task length exceeded 50ms, expressed in milliseconds. [Learn more about the Total Blocking Time metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/lighthouse-total-blocking-time/).
performance.why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (6,140 ms). This delays user interaction.
performance.fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

performance.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
performance.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
performance.why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (1.096). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.
performance.fix: Reserve space for images and advertisements, define width and height for media, avoid inserting content above existing content, and stabilize fonts before rendering.

performance.title: Speed Index
performance.description: Speed Index shows how quickly the contents of a page are visibly populated. [Learn more about the Speed Index metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/speed-index/).
performance.why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (4.5 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
performance.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

strengths: Bold, high-impact headline typography in the hero section immediately conveys core capabilities.
Clean contact form layout with straightforward form fields for incoming inquiries.

issues.issue: Severe Color Contrast Violation in Our Mission Section
issues.description: Dark gray paragraph text is placed directly over a bright red background in the 'OUR MISSION' section, making the body copy almost impossible to read and failing WCAG AA color contrast standards.
issues.recommendation: Change the paragraph text color to white (#FFFFFF) to establish strong visual contrast against the red background.

target.text: TagTeamSigns was established in 2001 to make the process of purchasing high quality, cost effective signs available to everyone.

issues.issue: Missing Primary Call-to-Action in Hero Section
issues.description: The prominent hero header features bold headline text but completely lacks a primary Call-to-Action (CTA) button above the fold, forcing users to scroll without direction.
issues.recommendation: Insert a high-contrast primary CTA button (e.g., 'Get a Free Quote' or 'Contact Us') directly beneath the hero headline text.

issues.description: The 'OUR SERVICES' section displays four small circular icons with no visible text labels, leaving users unable to identify what specific services are offered without interaction.
issues.recommendation: Add explicit text titles below each service icon (e.g., Design, Fabrication, Installation, Repair).

issues.issue: Low Contrast Bulleted Text over Image Background
issues.description: Red bullet point text in the 'WHO WE ARE' section is laid over a light, busy background image, causing poor legibility and eye strain.
issues.recommendation: Change bullet text color to dark gray/black and add a solid or opaque light background container behind the text block.

issues.issue: Small and Low-Contrast Top Navigation Bar
issues.description: The header navigation links are small and rendered in thin white font on a bright red background, making them difficult to scan and click quickly.
issues.recommendation: Increase font size to at least 16px, apply medium/bold weight, and increase tap/click targets with generous padding.

target.text: HOME SERVICES ABOUT US WORK CONTACT

issues.description: The site footer shows a copyright year of 2020, which can negatively impact trust signals and suggest an unmaintained website.
issues.recommendation: Update the copyright notice dynamically using JavaScript/backend logic to display the current year.
